voice.name: Open Sector - Heavy Assimilator
voice.note: Shares the Heavy Assimilator voice designed for the Stalker (voices/stalker.json): no new custom voice. A busy, methodical delivery for the walking forge. It carries no gun, so its attack lines send its Thralls instead (a right-click on an enemy still sends cmd.attack).
voice.description: Enormous, slow machine voice of a giant legged alien war machine of a cyborg hive: very deep sub-bass layered voice, as if several huge synthetic voices speak at once an octave apart, grinding metallic overtones and a rumbling engine-like drone beneath every word, cold, emotionless and inevitable, each word heavy and deliberate with long pauses.

birth.prompt: Small sci-fi nanite fabricator finishing a robot: a rising electric whir and crackle of assembling metal, quick ratcheting servo clicks, a hydraulic hiss as a hatch opens and a metal foot clanks down, close, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Small four-legged alien machine walking: light quick metallic leg steps clicking on the ground, small servo whines, a soft electric hum of a portable forge and faint liquid slosh in glass tanks, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Small alien machine destroyed: a sharp electric overload crackle, glass tanks shattering, a hissing burst of fizzing liquid, metal frame clattering apart and a dying synthetic whine falling in pitch, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
